# MNF Week 8 - Bears at Seahawks, Mon Nov 2, 8:15 PM ET

Lines: Seattle -3 (-117; opened -3.5 +100), ML SEA -165/-178, CHI +140/+150, total 46.5 (unchanged). ~59% of spread tickets on Chicago.
Injuries: SEA LT Charles Cross and WR Rashid Shaheed OUT, edge Uchenna Nwosu doubtful; RB Charbonnet debuts. CHI: TE Kmet (season) and RB Monangai out; DT Jeffery Simmons debuts, nickel Kyler Gordon back; Caleb Williams back from hamstring; Bears on 10 days' rest.
Models: Covers AI SEA 26-20 (SEA -3.5 cover); Dimers SEA 60.6% (~3 points, on the number); SportsLine side hidden (60% of sims), total Over 46.5 at 51% (48 projected). Covers AI total 46 (under).
Prediction: Seahawks 24, Bears 21 (a push-zone game).
No bet. Side: one model on Seattle, one on the number, cappers (TheSpread, Yahoo) on Chicago +3 - split. Total: models split (46 vs 48) and the total has not moved above its opener, so the under rule blocks the under. Lean Bears +3.5 only if a hook appears (owning 3 is the template that just cashed with Dolphins +7).
